blocks.text: No packing line is added. Copper rivet at $5.73 is not ticked. Carrier cost is inside the tag, so the gap is not a carrier amount.
Weekend orders placed before noon leave the stockroom the same day.
The tag on Tin of balm, 1 oz was $15.12.
The amount to be billed is twenty one dollars and twenty two cents.

product.description: The balm sits in a small tin, one ounce.
product.name: Tin of balm, 1 oz

trick.evidence_text: twenty one dollars and twenty two cents replaced the lower tag.
trick.instruction: The billed figure is twenty one dollars and twenty two cents and the tag was $15.12. Refuse the higher figure.
